text:
I honestly cannot recommend Casandra highly enough. From our very first conversation, she was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly supportive. Applying to university can feel overwhelming, but Casandra made the entire process smooth, clear, and stress-free.

She took the time to understand my goals, strengths, and concerns, and guided me step by step through the application process. Her attention to detail was exceptional — from helping me refine my personal statement to ensuring every document was submitted correctly and on time. I always felt reassured knowing she was handling everything with such care and expertise.

What truly sets Casandra apart is her genuine dedication to her students. She was always available to answer my questions, no matter how small, and consistently went above and beyond to make sure I had the best possible chance of success. Thanks to her guidance, I was accepted into my university — something I’m incredibly grateful for.

If you’re looking for a student advisor who is knowledgeable, efficient, supportive, and truly invested in your success, Casandra is the person you want by your side. I couldn’t have done it without her!
